description: Implement CaptureBackend using Windows.Graphics.Capture API (Win10 1903+). Provides per-window capture and handles DRM/protected content gracefully. Uses Direct3D11CaptureFramePool with CreateFreeThreaded for frame delivery. Fallback when DXGI DD fails (e.g., Secure Desktop, UAC, some fullscreen exclusive apps). Also enables window-specific capture that DXGI DD cannot do.
title: Windows Graphics Capture (WGC) fallback backend
